data.title: ZATCA Urges Establishments to File Excise Tax Returns for September and October
data.content:
Riyadh, November 22, 2026, SPA -- The Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) has urged establishments subject to excise tax to file their returns for September and October 2026 by November 30, 2026.
    It called on establishments to submit their returns promptly through its website (zatca.gov.sa) to avoid a late filing penalty of 5% to 25% of the tax due. A further 5% of the unpaid tax is charged for each month of delay or part of a month.
    Businesses seeking further information can call the authority's unified call center at 19993, available 24/7, or reach it through its "Ask Zakat, Tax and Customs" account on X (@Zatca_Care), email (info@zatca.gov.sa), or live chat on its website.
    Excise tax is one of the taxes in force in Saudi Arabia. It is imposed at varying rates on goods harmful to public health or the environment, including energy drinks, sweetened beverages, and tobacco and its derivatives.
    -- SPA
